title: Particular-calendar overlay metadata
description: The overlay.json singleton for one particular calendar (Core #76): its platform URN, display name, rite, and operation count. The operations themselves live in the sibling operations.ndjson (validated by overlay-operation.schema.json).

id.description: The overlay's platform URN; must be directorium:overlay:<rite>:<slug>.

rite.description: The rite the overlay layers over (v0.2: only roman).

operations.description: The number of operations in the sibling operations.ndjson.
